alternatives.root_cause: The ad JVM was killed for exceeding a lowered memory limit and cannot restart.
alternatives.why_not: The only recorded change is an image reference update, not a limit edit, and the shutdown message read as an orderly JVM shutdown rather than an OOM kill.

alternatives.root_cause: ad is running but cut off from the network, so callers cannot reach it.
alternatives.why_not: A partitioned-but-running ad would keep writing its own log complaining it cannot reach dependencies; instead ad writes nothing after 10:56 and callers get immediate unreachable errors.

alternatives.root_cause: frontend itself degraded and is failing its own ad route.
alternatives.why_not: frontend's error ratio did not depart from baseline and its failures name a remote endpoint it cannot connect to; its other downstream hops (cart, product-catalog) remained healthy and fast.

verdict.summary: The ad service was redeployed to a hotfix image reference at 10:56 and the new artifact never came back up, so its gRPC endpoint is unreachable and frontend's GetAds calls fail.
verdict.reasoning: frontend and frontend-proxy alerted but neither showed a sustained error-ratio departure (tr_725471f95500, tr_43ae1273c65e); the only errored spans in frontend traces were on the AdService/GetAds hop (tr_5ce5d02c9e88). The ad service's own log ends at 10:56 with a JVM shutdown and nothing after (tr_4aaa500e5a70), and its error-ratio series has intervals with no traffic at all (tr_9c988048660b), consistent with the process being gone rather than slow. A change record at 10:56:23 shows the image reference on ad updated to a hotfix tag from no prior reference (tr_0ba909c449c1), immediately after the shutdown. frontend then logs fast gRPC UNAVAILABLE/host-unreachable failures against the ad port (tr_5f2efcb7b515) rather than hanging to deadline, which rules out a freeze or partition of a running process: callers get refused, not stalled. The running artifact is not one that serves, so this is a bad deploy; frontend and frontend-proxy are only the services that noticed.
open_questions: Whether the new ad container crash-loops on start or was never scheduled at all — no ad logs exist after 10:56 to distinguish these.
Why the change log shows no prior image reference for ad, which makes it unclear what the previous good artifact was for rollback.
Whether cart, checkout, product-catalog, product-reviews and recommendation in the blast radius were affected at all, or only listed by graph adjacency.
